BiblicalUsage: The word means if not, or except, and it marks the turning point of a story: Jacob says except the God of his father had been with him, Laban would have sent him away empty. Abigail's haste kept David from bloodshed, and Joab says unless Abner had spoken, the fighting would have gone on till morning.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this small word carries some of the Bible's greatest mercies, because except God had stepped in, the story would have ended in ruin.
